role: Post hoc cross-drug supportive extension with analysis rules specified before the new VDZ patient-level association run; not public preregistration or fresh blinded validation

prior_access.claim_limit: Prior whole-matrix scoring is proven. Absence of a retained VDZ association script is not proof of no historical or external inspection.

W6.exposure: Include the three vdz_plac W6 samples as VDZ induction; future maintenance assignment is not a W6 exclusion or adjustment covariate.
W6.path_label_caution: Path labels include future maintenance assignment and are not baseline covariates; all three VDZ induction paths included.

W12.timing: Use deposited W12 visit; no relabeling to W6 or W14.

sample_rules.missing_W6: Subject30 has baseline but no W6; do not substitute W52.
sample_rules.noncore: W52 and off-schedule visits retained in the visit/disposition inventory, not used for inferential rescue.
sample_rules.placebo: Three W6 placebo pairs; no efficacy comparison planned.

endpoint: Follow-up Mayo endoscopic subscore0or1; separate from clinical response and histological healing.
scoring: Reuse exactly the frozen Candidate6, equal-weight mean log2 canonical gene expression and fixed common194 inflammation scores already in 002B. Follow-up minus baseline. No gene, weight, normalization or annotation tuning.
evaluation: At least two patients per endpoint group, complete fixed scores, full rank, residual df>=5. Non-evaluable primary is reported and not replaced by a secondary model. No expression- or influence-based exclusions.
reporting: OLS and HC3 t-based95%CI and exact two-sided nominalP for all three models at both visits; W6 adjusted OLS is the one principal supportive comparison. All patient influences and leave-one-patient-out estimates reported. No baseline prediction AUC or cutoff optimization.
references: Three already frozen reference programs, identical model within visit, descriptive BH over six reference comparisons. No superiority claim from comparingP values.

interpretation_rule.positive_W6: Positive coefficient and two-sidedP<0.05 provides supportive cross-drug association in sampled VDZ W6 biopsies, subject to CI and parallel models; not proof of a shared causal repair mechanism.
interpretation_rule.other_W6: Cross-drug support not established in this cohort/window. No inference of absence or antiTNF-specificity from nonsignificance.
interpretation_rule.W12: Secondary evidence always reported, never replaces principalW6.

forbidden_claims: Replaces or rescues the original GSE23597 primary result
Pooling clinical response and endoscopic healing P values
Prospectively unaccessed or never-scored VDZ data
A negative VDZ P value proves antiTNF specificity
IFX-versus-VDZ efficacy ranking or treatment interaction from separate significance tests
Baseline prediction, new repair mechanism, or independence from inflammation
Candidate6 superiority over CT_Colonocytes, OXPHOS, MARS or IBrD
limits: Only the fixed194 panel is adjusted; not all inflammation
Bulk score and endoscopic healing may share tissue composition or histological constructs
Small and imbalanced endpoint groups; W12 three healers only
VDZ versus IFX differences in time, prior treatment and exposure paths remain; disjoint released IDs within the series support separate participants, not independent institutions
Biopsy availability and off-schedule/withdrawal selection may bias the sampled groups
metadata_precision_note: W6 has6healers of27 versus IFX8of23. Larger totalN does not imply greater information or double evidence. W12 has3healers of13.
expansion_policy: Prioritize this bounded endoscopic extension now. Suspend broad clinical-response dataset searching for workload reasons; do not claim public data are exhausted or future validation impossible. GSE16879 excluded from eligible independent evidence until provenance independence is established; overlap not asserted as fact.
baseline_only_cohorts: Not used for current delta-score claim; any future baseline-prediction study would require a separate question and validation, and cannot be called validation of this lock.
